entries.brief: Original SKAZ fantasy reference-book spell illustration, D&D 2014. Painterly realistic materials, mature restrained palette, one clear bold motif readable at32px, composition centered in75% with wide transparent margin, no text/UI/border, no cartoon. Transparent background. An imposing flame elemental bowing toward a glowing precious gemstone with a luminous golden oath-thread linking them. Symbol of compelled service, not a cage or physical trap; no summoning portal.
